legal_name: LyKis Limited (per company website now trading/renamed as KrownIQ; exact new legal name not verified from MCA)
note: Registry data could not be verified: search backend (searx) returned connection refused, and all registry/aggregator pages (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck, Moneycontrol, Screener, Wikipedia) returned 403/404/429; BSE page returned only a JS shell with no content. Only primary source readable was the company's own site (lykis.com), which states it is a BSE-listed 3-Star Export House operating since 1984, and that 'GoldSpan Exports Pvt. Ltd. ... is a subsidiary of KrownIQ (formerly known as Lykis Limited)'. This is a self-declaration, not a registry record, so CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state and MCA status are all left null rather than guessed. Role assessed as manufacturer_trader from the site's description of in-house R&D/QC plus multi-product sourcing and private labelling, but this is also unverified. Revenue FY25/FY26 not obtained from audited accounts or official filings - null. No basis for rejection: no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy was found; the entity appears active and listed. HS codes 330610 (toothpaste) and 960321 (toothbrushes) are consistent with the declared oral-care brand (Lyfresh) but HS conformity is not a rejection ground per project rules.
